rounds.text: Shanmuga Hospital Ltd trades at a compelling discount, with a P/E ratio of 13.8x compared to a sector benchmark of 32.11x, alongside an EV/EBITDA of just 6.93x against its sector benchmark of 17.07x [E1, E6, E11]. The underlying business quality is supported by a solid ROA of 8.5% that outpaces the sector benchmark of 6.38%, and a strong historical return on equity track record including a 5-year median ROE of 25% [E8, E19, E41]. Financially, the company is conservatively managed with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.16x and total borrowings decreasing to Rs 6.73 Cr in Mar 2026, while demonstrating exceptional cash generation where operating cash flow reached Rs 12.31 Cr—representing 2.92x profit coverage [E25, E26, E29, E30]. Furthermore, the company benefits from a broader healthcare sector tailwind with a supportive tailwind score of up to +0.90, and recently showed positive operational momentum with sales up quarter-over-quarter [E44, E45, E46]. Conceded: a discounted cash flow model puts intrinsic value at Rs 34 per share which is below the current market price of Rs 43, and the company currently offers a 0.00% dividend yield [E4, E35].

A discounted cash flow model puts intrinsic value at Rs 34 per share against a market price of Rs 43, leaving a negative margin of safety of -24.7% [E35, E36]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF reveals that today's price already prices in 3.2% earnings growth, even though the base case assumes 0.0% growth [E37].
